content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate-I: B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical/Civil Engineering from a well-recognised university or equivalent. Prior knowledge of additive manufacturing methods/systems, Working knowledge in Finite element modelling/ Machine learning.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) for filling project-based research positions in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released for the Project Associate-I post under a specific research project in the mechanical engineering department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-I recruitment is 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical/Civil Engineering from a well-recognised university along with specified domain knowledge.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply for the post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate-I post will receive a monthly salary of upto 30000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through online mode only by visiting the official application portal and making necessary fee payments.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Project Associate-I post will be carried out through an Interview process.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification PDF by clicking the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
